rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a remark or someone’s expressed opinion or position.

example.english: I don't really agree with your statement.
example.traditional: 你呢個講法，我唔係幾同意。
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 ngo5 m4 hai6 gei2 tung4 ji3

rows.note: Use this for a formal declaration, especially an official or public statement of a position.

example.english: The government issued a formal statement about the matter.
example.traditional: 政府就件事發表咗正式聲明。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 zau6 gin6 si6 faat3 biu2 zo2 zing3 sik1 sing1 ming4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a document showing activity in a bank account.

example.english: I got my bank statement this morning and only then realized I spent too much last month.
example.traditional: 我今朝收到銀行結單，先發現上個月使多咗錢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 sau1 dou2 ngan4 hong4 git3 daan1 sin1 faat3 jin6 soeng6 go3 jyut6 sai2 do1 zo2 cin2
